breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly corrects the error by stating 'Ignore the earlier mention of polar second moment J; it was an error.' It then correctly uses the Euler-Bernoulli bending curvature formula κ = M / (E · I) with the planar second moment of area I, not the polar moment J, aligning with the ground truth.
